ess.title: Electronic Sales System
ess.shortDescription: ESS is a comprehensive system for managing electronic invoices and receipts. Issue, review, and send documents to the Egyptian Tax Authority while tracking their status—all from one integrated platform, no software installation needed.
ess.description:
ESS – Electronic Sales System is a comprehensive system for managing electronic invoices and receipts, allowing companies to create, review, and send documents to the Egyptian Tax Authority while tracking their status and managing sales operations from a single integrated platform. It goes beyond simply sending documents to the tax authority—it provides an integrated environment to issue, manage, and track their status from one unified location.

Master data is stored once: products, customers, and suppliers. You organize everything by branch, POS device, activity, currency, tax, and measurement unit. Users access the system from any device with permissions tailored to their role, enabling centralized document management while maintaining data consistency across branches. Manage multiple companies from a single account, each with its own independent file for branches, activities, POS devices, currencies, taxes, and units. Switch between companies based on your permissions. ESS supports bulk operations through customizable Excel files and flexible printing templates that match your business type—A4, A5, or thermal formats.

With ESS you get easier management, greater control, and higher efficiency.

features.title: Unified management
features.detail: Manage all your business data in one place: products, customers, suppliers, branches, POS devices, and users. Store master data once and reuse it across all documents. Organize everything by branch, activity, POS device, currency, tax, and measurement unit. No duplicate data entry—one source of truth for your entire operation.

features.title: Operational flexibility
features.detail: Access ESS from any device, anywhere. Manage user access and permissions according to your business structure. Each user sees only what they need, and approval workflows respect role-based permissions. Switch between companies without re-logging in. Work across multiple devices while maintaining consistent data and permissions.

features.title: Easier migration
features.detail: Move from your old system without manual data entry. Bulk import products, customers, suppliers, and transaction data through customizable Excel files. Monitor import jobs in real time. Update product or customer information once, and changes reflect automatically on all future documents.

features.title: Control & tracking
features.detail: Monitor all your invoices and receipts in one place: see their status at the tax authority (accepted, rejected, or processing), manage product coding requests, and track tax authority feedback. View GPC and portal codes without opening the official tax portal each time. One screen for your team: issue, send, code, and track.

features.title: Bulk submission
features.detail: Issue and send multiple invoices and receipts at once using customizable Excel files. Handle large document volumes efficiently with bulk operations. Perfect for high-volume processing, end-of-day batch submissions, or migrating historical transactions.

features.title: Tailored issuance & printing
features.detail: Choose from multiple templates and sizes to print invoices and receipts that match your business type. Print A4 or A5 for the office, or thermal format at the point of sale. Templates automatically pull company name, branch, customer data, line items, and totals so every receipt looks professional and consistent. Reprint anytime from the document view without recreating the transaction.

features.title: Multi-company management
features.detail: Run multiple companies from a single account. Each company has its own independent profile: separate branches, activities, POS devices, currencies, taxes, and units. Switch between companies effortlessly based on your permissions. Centralize access control while keeping company data isolated and organized.

features.title: Easier management, greater control, higher efficiency
features.detail: ESS combines integrated workflow, flexible permissions, and bulk capabilities to give you one unified platform for document management. Spend less time on administrative tasks, gain full visibility into your operations, and handle larger transaction volumes without increasing overhead.

ers.title: POS E-Receipts
ers.shortDescription: Designed specifically for retail point-of-sale teams. Issue e-receipts instantly, send them to the tax authority, and monitor their status from a centralized cloud dashboard.
ers.description:
Designed specifically for retail point-of-sale teams to issue e-receipts instantly and send them to the tax authority from one fast cashier screen. A cashier selects items, issues a receipt or return in seconds, and the system automatically encrypts and sends it to the Egyptian Tax Authority. From one centralized dashboard, you manage branches, POS devices, cashier permissions, and track receipt status in real time. The cloud-based monitoring panel shows daily sales performance, acceptance and rejection rates, and net shift totals from anywhere, without needing to stand at the cashier.

ERS combines ease of use with complete tax compliance, designed for speed and accuracy at the point of sale.

features.title: Instant receipt issuance
features.detail: A purpose-built fast cashier interface with minimal fields and maximum speed. Select items, set quantity, issue a sales receipt or return in seconds. The interface strips away complex invoice fields to minimize errors during peak hours. Upon issuance, receipts are encrypted and sent instantly to the tax authority automatically—no extra steps required from the cashier.

features.title: Branch and POS device management
features.detail: Precise organizational structure: register each cashier device as an independent POS linked to a specific branch and tax-approved activity code. This ensures every receipt is attributed to the correct device and branch, preventing shift data from mixing and eliminating tax rejection risks. Set up branches, devices, and activity codes once in centralized settings, then the cashier operates the simplified screen with zero daily reconfiguration.

features.title: Data management and bulk import
features.detail: Centralized management of items, customers, prices, tax brackets, measurement units, and customer categories through dedicated screens. Items appear ready-to-pick at the cashier, and customers can be linked to receipts seamlessly without slowing the shift. For seamless system integration, use advanced bulk import tools to upload items, customers, or receipts from external files, with real-time import progress tracking.

features.title: Receipt status tracking
features.detail: Detailed receipt lifecycle monitoring with intelligent categorization: locally valid, in-process, tax authority approved, or rejected. Rejected receipts are highlighted as urgent alerts, enabling supervisors to review and correct them immediately before shift closing. Returns are displayed separately to prevent mixing with sales totals. Status accuracy is guaranteed—each status reflects the official response from the tax authority, not a local device estimate.

features.title: Thermal cashier print
features.detail: Pre-configured thermal printer templates optimized for point-of-sale efficiency. Issue a professional customer receipt immediately after sale with zero layout setup required each shift. The system automatically pulls entity name, branch, POS device number, and transaction totals from centralized settings to ensure uniform branding across all cashiers. Reprint any receipt with a single tap if paper jams or the customer requests a copy.

features.title: Shift sales dashboard
features.detail: Panoramic performance view for any time period (daily, weekly, or monthly): total receipts, locally valid, tax authority approved, in-process, and rejected counts. Compare sales against returns to extract accurate net shift totals. Monitor from any connected device—supervisors track performance remotely without standing at the cashier. Intelligent financial filter counts only complete valid receipts, excluding in-process transactions to prevent number distortion during shift close decisions.

esa.title: Electronic Signature Agent
esa.shortDescription: An advanced electronic signature application designed as a practical and modern alternative to ePass2003, enabling secure and easy use of e-signature and e-seal certificates across different platforms and electronic portals.
esa.description:
ESA – Electronic Signature Agent is an advanced electronic signature application designed as a practical and modern alternative to ePass2003, enabling secure and easy use of e-signature and e-seal certificates across different platforms and electronic portals. It keeps pace with the growing reliance on electronic signing in digital transactions, providing a reliable solution for use in different business environments and electronic services.

ESA provides a more stable and user-friendly signing experience while maintaining the highest security standards. It protects against user mistakes, supports multiple signing device types, and integrates seamlessly with the Egyptian Tax Authority's requirements. Whether you're signing invoices, receipts, or other critical documents, ESA delivers dependable performance with comprehensive device support and fail-safe operation.

With ESA you get higher efficiency and dependable security.

features.title: Comprehensive support for signing devices
features.detail: ESA supports various types of electronic signature devices (USB Tokens). Works with different device types without compatibility issues, providing a unified solution for electronic signing across your organization.

features.title: User-error protection
features.detail: Designed to reduce operational errors and usage mistakes, ensuring a safer and more stable signing experience. The application guides users through the signing workflow with clear prompts and confirmations, minimizing the risk of incorrect signatures or rejected documents.

features.title: Compatible with tax portal requirements
features.detail: Designed to operate according to approved e-signature standards required by the Egyptian Tax Authority. Works seamlessly with ESS and ERS for invoice and receipt signing, supporting the full tax compliance workflow without additional configuration.

features.title: Simpler, more stable signing experience
features.detail: Delivers an easier and more stable electronic signature experience compared to ePass2003. The modern interface makes signing intuitive, and the stable performance ensures signing operations complete reliably without interruptions or failures.

features.title: Practical modern alternative to ePass2003
features.detail: Built as a practical replacement for ePass2003 with all the functionality you need plus a smoother user experience. Maintains compatibility with existing workflows while providing better stability and a clearer signing interface.

features.title: Higher efficiency and dependable security
features.detail: ESA combines greater signing efficiency with reliable protection. Spend less time on signing operations, gain confidence in security, and maintain consistent document integrity across your entire organization.
